messages:
sofia: FYI we have a customs hold at FRA for the H200 shipment (AWB: H200AWB9988). Customs flagged missing ECC cert and won't release. Carrier says hold until docs cleared. 12 units inbound, initial triage shows 3 with DOA markings on receipt. photos in drive.

dan: Oof. Tagging @natalie (vendor) and @kevin to confirm paperwork. Do we have backup pool for EU capacity if these are out for >72h?

kevin: We can spare up to 6 loaner units from warm pool for 48h but that drops our reserve. If hold >5 business days we need longer-term provisioning from US or APAC and plan for cross-region latency impacts.

ops-bot: Case created: RMA-2026-FRA-ECC: "H200 customs hold + DOA" assigned to @priya.

priya: Oncall. Quick ask: can vendor provide ECC certs and will they accept depot RMA for the DOA units? Also what's vendor stance on expedited air-replacement billing?

natalie (vendor): Sorry — we'll pull the ECC cert PDF from our compliance bucket and send it within 3 hours. For the DOA: we can offer depot collection OR express exchange from our EU swap stock. Express exchange costs are typically absorbed by vendor if DOA confirmed on arrival scan + carrier PIR. If customs hold is due to paperwork, vendor will push docs but air-expedite billing depends on root cause (carrier vs packing). We'll escalate logistics lead.

sofia: Photos + arrival scan uploaded: https://redwood-drive/claims/H200AWB9988/photos. DOA serials: `H200-2201,H200-2207,H200-2212`. Full manifest at https://redwood-drive/claims/H200AWB9988/manifest.csv

dan: Finance ping: if we accept vendor exchange but vendor charges for air uplift, what's the cap we can approve without executive signoff? @kevin

kevin: We have a $25k ad-hoc expedite window for supply ops. Anything >$25k needs director signoff. Air uplift per unit approx $3.2k; for 9 units that's ~28.8k (over). We should discuss splitting cost vs using warm-pool loaners.

priya: Operational impact: cluster EU-gpu-pool will be short ~20% capacity if we don't backfill. That will push some latency-sensitive jobs to US and may breach SLO for two customers. Suggest we provision 4 loaners immediately and start paperwork for vendor exchange.

natalie (vendor): Understood. We'll send ECC cert + signed commercial invoice and RA form. For express exchange we can earmark 6 EU swap units pending RMA approval; ETA 48-72h after paperwork clear and customs release. If carrier fault confirmed, vendor will push courier at no charge.

sofia: Carrier statement says pallet arrived crushed at hub, but customs hold is specifically missing cert. I'm pushing carrier PIR request now. Uploaded carrier note: https://redwood-drive/claims/H200AWB9988/carrier_note.pdf

dan: Action plan proposal: 1) Supply to move 4 loaners from warm pool to FRA staging (kevin) 2) Vendor to submit ECC cert + RA form within 3h (natalie) 3) Ops to open carrier PIR (sofia) 4) Finance to pre-approve up to $25k expedite, and escalate if vendor requests >$25k (dan). Agree?

kevin: I can start loaner routing now. ETA to FRA staging 14-18h (ground). If customs still blocking at hub, we may need air uplift. I'll also tag supply-bot to reserve units.

supply-bot: Reserved 4 warm-pool units (H200) for staging. Reservation ID: RES-7421. Estimated ground ETA 16h.

priya: Note on RMA: please include photos of damaged packaging and arrival scan. We need vendor sign-off to mark DOA vs transit damage. If it's transit damage, vendor expects carrier claim first.

natalie (vendor): We'll include statement: if DOA validated at receipt, vendor will cover replacement shipping. If transit damage validated, vendor will coordinate claim with carrier and can pre-ship exchange pending recovery.

sofia: Uploaded full evidence + ASN: https://redwood-drive/claims/H200AWB9988/evidence.zip. Also added customs contact email for ECC cert upload.

dan: OK moving forward with loaners + paperwork. Finance please note provisional ledger: mark contingent vendor credit until PIR clears. @trevor-finance (offline).

kevin: Loaners en route. If vendor exchange ETA looks >72h, we'll prep to extend loaner allocation and shift some jobs.

priya: Small infra note: disabled auto-scale aggressive prefetch for EU pool to avoid excessive token cost while capacity strained. Rolling back once backfill confirmed.

natalie (vendor): Sent ECC cert + RA form to redwood-ops@ and cc'd logistics lead. Email subject: "ECC + RA for H200AWB9988". Will follow up on carrier fault determination.

ops-bot: Update logged on RMA-2026-FRA-ECC: "Vendor submitted ECC & RA form". Next: await carrier PIR.

sofia: Thanks team. I'll keep the incident active and post a status update in 2h or sooner if PIR arrives. :white_check_mark:
